cc:Work.dc:title: The geography of industrial production
cc:Work.dc:description: Production in 2019 and 2050 in the 12 largest producer groups, selected and ordered once by 2050 output under NDC+LTT (baseline_noce). The same fixed groups and ordering are used under NDC (ndc_noce), so differences between pathways are compared for the same regions. Each group has two vertically offset endpoint pairs: NDC above with a solid connector, and NDC+LTT below with a dashed connector. Open circles denote 2019; filled sector-coloured diamonds denote 2050. Panels show cement output (a), total primary-plus-secondary steel output (b), and total primary-plus-secondary aluminium output (c). Other model regions sums all producer groups outside the selected cohort and is not included in the ranking. Panel annotations give the fixed cohort's shares of global 2050 production in NDC / NDC+LTT order. Europe combines five model regions (ENE, ENW, EUE, EUM and EUW). Indonesia group combines Indonesia, Philippines and Viet Nam. Values are extracted directly from results_allCE_261002.csv using exact production variable and Mt/yr selections; source variables and constituent model regions are recorded with every observation. Horizontal ranges include both pathways within each sector, and sectors have different ranges. Logarithmic axes compare production magnitudes. Draft assumption: missing additive activity = zero.
